newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-South Australia start slowly against Tasmania.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-South Australia start slowly against Tasmania.

text.p: South Australia have made a cautious start after winning the toss and deciding to bat in their Sheffield Shield match against Tasmania.
South Australia were 21 for no wicket in fine conditions at Bellerive Oval.
Tasmania will move into second place in the Sheffield Shield standings behind Western Australia with an outright victory over the visitors, who prop up the table.
